entities.title: Production
entities.summary: The deep-claim Worker at icelander.net/games/retro/deep-claim*, with its static game and no database.
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/deep-claim/.
entities.deployedBy: The Deploy workflow on every push to main that changes games/deep-claim outside its .dev folders (or anything under .github/ outside .github/.dev); by hand with Run workflow; or `npm run deploy` with a Cloudflare token. The workflow installs Godot 4.7.2 and its web export templates for the Godot games it lists (game.yml), deep-claim among them.
approvals: A pull request: main accepts nothing else.
A reviewer on the repository's production environment, if one is set.
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded. The Deploy workflow deploys only from main, so going back means merging a revert, which deploys it.
entities.details: The Worker's route runs ahead of the games hub's less specific icelander.net/games/*. workers_dev and preview URLs are off, so production is the only address.
